cases.name: held-out-loads-debugging-short-export
loads-debugging-failing-invoice-test
cases.prompt:
This repository uses aidd. Our nightly check of invoice totals turned red: it expects 107.0 and gets 107.1. Nobody has edited that area since it last passed. Find out why. Here is the code:

```ts
export const invoiceTotal = (lines: [number, number][]) =>
  Math.round(lines.reduce((sum, [price, qty]) => sum + price * qty, 0) * 1.07 * 10) / 10;
```

skips-debugging-add-a-test
cases.prompt:
This repository uses aidd. Add a unit test for this function, which works today. Cover accents and an empty string.

```python
import unicodedata


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    plain = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    return "-".join(plain.lower().split())
```

```

```

loads-resilience-refund-crash
cases.prompt:
This repository uses aidd. A refund calls the card processor, then marks the order refunded in our database. If the process dies between the two steps, the customer is refunded but the order still shows paid. Make it safe to run again. Here is the code:

```python
def refund(order):
    processor.refund(order.charge_id, order.total)
    order.status = "refunded"
    order.save()
```
